title: Towards Reliable VLM Judges: State-Conditional Invariance and Presentation-Aware Diagnostics
abstract: arXiv:2611.13596v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal and embodied tasks, yet aggregate accuracy or consistency alone does not reveal whether a judge changes its verdict for the right reason. We propose State-Conditional Invariance (SCI), a reliability principle requiring a judge to remain stable under semantics-preserving changes in presentation while responding to causal interventions that change the task outcome. We instantiate SCI in GridWM-Judge, a simulator-grounded diagnostic benchmark built from deterministic MiniGrid trajectories with aligned Full, evidence-removal, and counterfactual variants, plus presentation and representation probes. Across five diagnostic tasks, GridWM-Judge tests local perception, action-conditioned transitions, presentation stability, representation exchangeability, and Full-CF causal discrimination. translated_title: 迈向可靠的视觉语言模型评判者：状态条件不变性与呈现感知诊断
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）日益被用作多模态和具身任务的自动评判者，然而仅凭总体准确率或一致性无法揭示评判者改变其判决是否出于正确的原因。我们提出了状态条件不变性（SCI）这一可靠性原则，要求评判者在语义保持不变的呈现变化下保持稳定，同时对改变任务结果的因果干预作出相应变化。我们在GridWM-Judge中实现了SCI，这是一个基于模拟器的诊断基准，由确定性的MiniGrid轨迹构建，包含对齐的完整、证据移除和反事实变体，以及呈现与表示探针。通过五个诊断任务，GridWM-Judge测试局部感知、动作条件转移、呈现稳定性、表示可交换性以及Full-CF因果判别能力。我们的诊断评估揭示了异质性的失败模式，包括……
tldr: 该论文提出状态条件不变性（SCI）这一可靠性原则，并构建了基于模拟器的诊断基准GridWM-Judge，用于系统评估视觉语言模型评判者在语义不变的呈现变化下是否保持稳定、并对改变任务结果的因果干预作出正确响应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes State-Conditional Invariance (SCI) as a reliability principle and introduces GridWM-Judge, a simulator-grounded diagnostic benchmark, to systematically evaluate whether VLM judges remain stable under semantics-preserving presentation changes while responding correctly to causal interventions that alter task outcomes.
